summary: INI and YAML are the built-in inventory formats. Bracketed headings in INI are groups, which follow variable naming rules, and the same inventory in YAML uses ungrouped/webservers/dbservers with hosts keys.
questions: What does a basic Ansible inventory file look like?
How do I write the same inventory in YAML?
What naming rules apply to group names?

answer_card.title: Basic INI and YAML inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
INI:
```ini
mail.example.com

[webservers]
foo.example.com
bar.example.com

[dbservers]
one.example.com
```
YAML:
```yaml
ungrouped:
  hosts:
    mail.example.com:
webservers:
  hosts:
    foo.example.com:
    bar.example.com:
dbservers:
  hosts:
    one.example.com:
```
Group names follow the same rules as valid variable names.
